Part 1 必考 地点 PLACE

The city you live in

你居住的城市

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1What city do you live in?

Well, I live in Shenzhen, which is one of the biggest first-tier cities in China, down in the south. It's a modern, fast-growing metropolis, so there's always something new going on around me.

我住在深圳，中国南方的一线城市，现代化大都市，变化很快。

Q2Do you like this city? Why?

To be honest, yes, I really do. I like the convenience and all the opportunities it offers, especially in tech and business. The thing is, though, the pace of life is a bit too fast for me sometimes.

喜欢，方便、机会多，但节奏太快有时有点累。

Q3How long have you lived in this city?

Actually, I've lived here my whole life, ever since I was born. Shenzhen is my permanent home, and I've watched it grow and change over the years, which has been quite interesting to experience.

从出生就住这里，深圳就是我的永久家园。

Q4Are there big changes in this city?

Oh yes, absolutely. Shenzhen is constantly changing, you know, new metro lines, new skyscrapers and whole districts keep appearing. It's one of the most rapidly developing cities in the country, honestly.

变化非常大，新地铁、新大楼、新城区不断出现。

Q5Is this city your permanent residence?

Yes, it is. I was born here and I consider Shenzhen my permanent residence. All my family and friends are here too, so I can't really imagine living anywhere else long-term.

是的，深圳是我的永久居住地，家人朋友都在这里。

Q6Are there people of different ages living in this city?

Definitely. Shenzhen attracts people of all ages, from young graduates chasing opportunities to retired people who have settled here. It's quite a diverse mix, which makes the city feel lively and never boring.

各年龄段都有，年轻人和退休的人很多，城市很有活力。

Q7Are the people friendly in this city?

Yeah, I'd say so. Most people here are quite friendly and helpful, even though it's a huge city. I mean, strangers will happily give you directions or help you carry things, which surprised me at first.

挺友善的，虽然城市大，但陌生人也很热心帮忙。

Q8Is the city friendly to children and old people?

Yes, I think it is, actually. There are plenty of parks and playgrounds for kids, and the metro and buses are really convenient for the elderly. The city seems well designed for both groups, which I appreciate.

对小孩老人很友好，公园多，地铁公交都方便。

Q9Do you often see your neighbors?

Not really, to be honest. I see them occasionally in the lift or at the entrance, and we say hello, but we don't chat much. It's the same for a lot of people in big cities, I guess.

不常碰见，电梯里遇到就打个招呼，大城市都这样。

Q10What's the weather like where you live?

Well, the weather in Shenzhen is hot and humid for most of the year. Summers are particularly sticky and uncomfortable, but winters are mild, which is actually quite pleasant compared to other parts of China.

天气湿热为主，夏天黏糊糊的，冬天温和舒服。

Q11Would you recommend your city to others?

Yes, I would, definitely. Shenzhen is such a prosperous and bustling city, full of energy and opportunities. I'd recommend it to anyone who wants a vibrant career, though I'd warn them about the fast pace.

会推荐，深圳很繁华、机会多，但要适应快节奏。
